stem: A batch includes healthy established transplants and several weakly rooted plants. What is the strongest establishment decision?
choices: Advance plants according to root condition and readiness, holding or correcting weak material rather than forcing the entire batch to one date
Transplant all plants together because batch uniformity is more important than root health
Remove acclimation steps so all plants finish on schedule
rationale: Root establishment is a major determinant of transplant resilience, so timing should reflect biological readiness rather than batch age alone.
